answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A sable of per-task receipts records who did what, and the hollow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the ember of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
